citations.desc: Attending veterinarian and adequate veterinary care (dealers and exhibitors).
citations.narrative:
The facility is currently using expired medications to treat birds. In the nursery room, there is a bottle of Vetericyn Plus
spray that expired in April 2025 and a tube of eye ointment that expired in March 2026. The facility representative
confirmed that both medications are in use.
The use of expired medications is not considered to be a safe or appropriate method to prevent, control, diagnose, and
treat diseases and injuries since the expected results cannot be guaranteed. The facility must ensure the use of
appropriate methods to prevent, control, diagnose, and treat diseases and injuries.
To be corrected by August 31, 2026.

The facility is not maintaining a current record of animals on hand or records of animals hatched while in their possession.
The records do not reflect the current total number of birds at the facility, the species present at the facility, or the dates of
acquisition for hatched birds.
Improper recordkeeping does not allow APHIS officials to properly account for animals on the premises or allow for proper
tracking of animals. Every dealer shall make, keep, and maintain records or forms which fully and correctly disclose all
information required by the AWA concerning animals purchased or otherwise acquired, owned, held, leased, or otherwise
in his or her possession or under his or her control, or which is transported, sold, euthanized, or otherwise disposed of by
that dealer or exhibitor. The records shall include any offspring born or hatched of any animal while in his or her
possession or under his or her control, to the extent that any identification or counting of offspring can be carried out
without unduly disturbing nesting or rearing activities.
To be corrected by September 25, 2026.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with a facility representative.
